subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘SHIP’ is written as ‘T17O’ and 'KITE' is written as 'L29D'. How will ‘HOPE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Second and third letters** ⇒ Sum of the position value according to the English alphabetic series is written.
 
• Last letter ⇒ (1) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So, 

 
• ‘SHIP’ is written as ‘T17O’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6de9dee4eaaddd1f575a94196824c9814ea9de12e3745ebd2a7e7689341c962.png] 

​And,

 
• 'KITE' is written as 'L29D'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fb4b2b829b949699fc24dfb1194833a3e80d4f1350f53d928fb55e66b2d2399.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘HOPE’ is written as:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96c4681b3d4ec96bd7ba2fc41dabedba97a1db10bf7b9d8a6005dc95d5d07e38.png] 

​Hence, "**I31D**" is the correct answer.
